independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG4 implementation, test, register row, ADR or decision in the reviewed candidate. I formed this verdict from my own runs before reading any other reviewer's round-1 record (none was visible to me). The runs were in a complete, non-shallow disposable clone of a91d82c under $TMPDIR, whose node_modules were copied with cp -a from the repository (lockfile byte-identical). I wrote new probes for DG4: dom-api.mjs (live HTTP, with the playbook as the oracle), dom-ui.mjs (Chromium, EN and AR) and zz-domain-r1.test.ts (in-process). The last was copied into the clone only and removed afterwards. Nothing in the candidate tree was modified, and the candidate ID is unchanged after my runs. Every in-product approval in my probes is a synthetic demo decision that approves nothing real. No product gate G1-G6 implies any engineering gate DG0-DG7.

checks_run.procedure: Live API, on a new transformation: the status model; closure by SP and by TL; PATCH status closed; the workspace header with eight elements; the Executive Overview's six areas; the T10 RAG on empty data; a dev.admin (ADM-only) gate decision.
checks_run.command: dom-api.mjs sections STATUS, HEADER, OVERVIEW, T10, ADM (run 2)
checks_run.expected: Delivery, value, BAU and closure are separate states, with no 'successful' label. Closure refused. PATCH closed 422. Eight header elements, Unknown where missing. Six overview areas in T10 order. No data never green. ADM 403.
checks_run.actual: status-model: deliveryState in_delivery, valueState no_benefit, bauState no_performance_area, closureState open, label 'In delivery'. SP close 403 (no closure permission); TL close 422 closure.transformation_not_open; PATCH closed 422 invalid_transition, 'A transformation cannot be closed by a status edit. Closure requires the G6 (Sustain) business approval with validated benefits; use the closure action.' Header: all 8 present; northStar unknown, outcomeHealth unknown, benefits state unknown (never 0). Overview: outcomes, value, portfolio, dependencies, decisions, people_adoption. T10 on empty data: Outcomes unknown, Value not_applicable, Portfolio not_applicable, People & adoption unknown. Dependencies and Decisions are green with the explicit rules dashboard.rag.*.none_open: a known 'no open blocker or ask' state, not missing data. ADR-0037 §3 documents this, and I accept it as consistent with B0095 ('Red if executive decision overdue'). Headline values carry explicit states (zero, not_applicable, unknown), never a bare 0. ADM-only gate decision 403. QA-C O-2 judgment: the playbook defines no transformation record lifecycle, and gates are phase approvals (B0022/B0023). The source never says a gate approval activates the record, and the operating rule that nothing is inferred from approvals favours explicit activation. The product keeps 'draft' until a person activates it, and governed closure needs an active or on-hold record (closure.transformation_not_open). This does not contradict the source. I record it as an observation, not a defect. Run 1 disclosed: HEADER.exception, a probe defect (I called /overview without the required organizationId query parameter, 400 validation). Fixed in run 2, where it passes.

checks_run.procedure: In-process domain probe (zz-domain-r1.test.ts, 3 tests, on the real API and a disposable DB). DOM-GROSS: planned values revenue_uplift 300, margin_uplift 70, cash_saving 20, avoided_cost 45; read the per-class lines, gross and net. DOM-CURRENCY: a SAR benefit and a USD benefit. DOM-NA: a CX benefit without a valuation method. Plus a source review of benefits/totals.ts and ADR-0030 §7.

checks_run.expected: Lines kept apart per class and currency; no currency conversion; a CX benefit n/a (nonFinancialCount +1, SAR figures byte-identical). The question asked: which classes the gross and net headlines add.
checks_run.actual: 3/3 tests pass. Lines are apart: revenue_uplift 300, margin_uplift 70, cash_saving 20, avoided_cost 45. Currencies are separate blocks, [SAR 100] and [USD 7], never summed. CX: currencies [] before and after, nonFinancialCount 0 -> 1 (n/a, never 0). Decimal arithmetic throughout (decimal.js; A05 S16-025 green in DOM-R1-03). Forecast, submitted, upside-scenario and overlap-pending values are never validated: A10 S08-001/014/016/018 are green, and totals.ts reads one state per line and never reads scenarios. Shared benefits are counted once (A10 PB-058, 10 M SAR once). Finance-only validation, and amendment/reversal with both records visible, are green in A10 S08-015/S08-017/PB-013. DEFECT FOUND: gross.planned = 435 = 300 + 70 + 20 + 45 and net.planned = 435. The headline adds revenue uplift to margin, and avoided cost to cash saving, which M0172 says to keep separate. Raised as F-DG4-121 (Medium, not mandatory; no literal acceptance clause broken). The check passes as an executed probe: its three assertions hold, and the defect is recorded as a finding. Observation (no finding): the T14 Status R/A/G is a user-entered field with a note, Unknown when unset, never green (ADR-0029 §2). B0123 gives no rule for it, and the computed T10 Value RAG never reads it.

checks_run.command: Reading apps/api/src/modules/reporting/dashboards/areas.ts lines 1-25; apps/worker/src/handlers/escalations.ts lines 10-30 and 286-360; apps/api/src/modules/workflows/gates.ts lines 890-925; docs/architecture/adr/ADR-0007 status table; requirements.csv notes for the 137 rows

checks_run.actual: T10: Outcomes reads only KPI statuses ('never deliverables, milestones, actions, work items or completion', B0095 'not activity completion'); Value = validated-benefit gap, with forecast, submitted and scenario values shown but never counted; Portfolio = milestone + outcome; Dependencies = needed-by / decision / critical path; Decisions = red when overdue; People = adoption curve. Escalation: chain from the T11 row, else the stored rule, else SP. The next entry after the last escalated party, skipping the ask's owner. One decision_escalation row per step under an advisory lock; never decides (no decision column written). Unmapped or exhausted chains are visible routing errors. Consistent with 'escalate once to the next authority'. QA-B 409 vs 422 judgment: a decision on a Draft gate has no pending submission. The DG2-approved engine answers 409 version-conflict gate.submission_superseded, 'There is no pending submission to decide.', and writes nothing. REQ-S04-010 requires only that Draft -> Approved is 'rejected', and the decideGate contract defines 409 for a non-current submission. A purist reading of ADR-0007 would say 422 invalid-transition, but changing it would reopen a DG2-approved behaviour, and nothing is written either way. I accept it as an observation, not a finding. Register partials (PB-010 scorecard re-read; PB-065, S04-014, S07-015 API-only and not real-stack e2e; PB-066 and S15-008 server clock not settable; S04-010 409; S08-006 rates as formula variables; S07-005 negative baseline unit-only; S20-005 'stale' outside the A05 suite; S20-011 no root A11 e2e; S12-005 single-owner fixture; ERD inspections): each is disclosed plainly, each clause is still proven by an executed test on the same engine (green in DOM-R1-02/03), and none hides a behaviour gap. I judge them acceptable. The REQ-DLV-036 note says the run on the frozen candidate 'has not happened yet'. DOM-R1-03 is that run, and it is green.

summary: PASS, with two non-blocking findings. I recomputed the candidate ID on a complete clone: 19656b1f…, 1449 files, unchanged after my runs. The validators pass: register DG4, and historical DG3/DG2/DG1. On Node 22 and 24, typecheck, build and lint are clean, and the unit tests give 2771 passed plus 259 passed and 2 skipped (by design). The full integration project passes 203 files / 1925 tests on the frozen candidate, including every acceptance suite (A03, A04, A05, A08, A09, A10, A11, A12-A14). That is REQ-DLV-036's review-time run. With the playbook as the oracle, the API's seeds match verbatim: T11 (B0099), T12 (B0101), the five layers (B0093), the seven indicators (B0109-B0115), the six phases (B0021), the G5/G6 evidence (B0023) and the T10 areas (B0095). The register refusals hold: RACI X and two A, Hostile, the T15 probability rule, and T16's seven ask elements. Status separation and the closure guard hold, the header shows Unknown, and ADM gets 403. The EN/AR screens hold, with the provisional wordmark, provisional Arabic labels and no certification claim. Findings: F-DG4-121 (Medium): the benefit totals' gross and net headlines add revenue uplift to margin, and avoided cost to cash saving (300+70+20+45 = 435), against M0172. F-DG4-120 (Low): the Arabic T11 page shows the English source labels with no provisional notice. Judged: QA-C O-2 (draft until explicit activation) does not contradict the source; QA-B's 409 for a Draft-gate decision is acceptable (rejected, nothing written, DG2 behaviour); the register partial disclosures are acceptable.
